name: Schrödinger's Man
source:
Chris has been out for years, always upfront to potential partners about the fact he's trans. Unfortunately, his latest James didn't want to admit he didn't know what that meant. Now Chris has to come out again, but maybe James will figure something out about himself in the process.

[From [url=https://whitefort.itch.io/schrdingers-man]itch.io[/url]]
